# THE NIGHT UNC – dev workflow & session knowledge

## Project & deploy
- Repo: Ragnorus/GuaraGameJam2026, branch `main`. Godot 4.5.
- Live: https://guaragamejam2026-production.up.railway.app/ . Railway builds the `Dockerfile` (Godot 4.5.1 headless web export, served by nginx via `nginx.conf.template`) on every push to `main`; takes a few minutes. Hard-reload (Ctrl+F5) to bypass cache.
- `export_presets.cfg`: web export is **single-threaded** (`variant/thread_support=false`) so it works without COOP/COEP headers.
- Godot/Python may not be installed locally; validate with Node tools (`tools/`), previews and the browser. If Godot is available: open the project, F5 (main scene is `scenes/main_menu.tscn`); `tools/smoke_test.gd` and `tests/difficulty_score.gd` are headless checks.
- Git: keep `*.import` and `*.uid` tracked (Godot generates them; needed for export). LF/CRLF warnings are harmless. Resolve merge conflicts directly when asked.

## Levels & bosses
- **Yeral level**: `main.gd` delegates to `YeralRoute` (`scripts/yeral_route.gd`). Five ordered areas from the user's sketch: city approach, stepped sewer descent, sergeant room (three fixed platforms over lethal green acid), moving-block sewer ascent, city warehouse approach, then a separate 1280px warehouse boss room. City art only in Areas 1/5; sewer/warehouse use original generated PNGs. Room exits wait for their guards/sergeant; ascent exit requires reaching the upper ledge. Short locked/faded transitions animate sewer entry/exit and warehouse entry. The warehouse introduction shows exact comic speech and plays `assets/audio/yeral_intro.wav` through SFX before boss activation; all gameplay controls locked, friendly attacks cleared, boss untargetable. Pause/restart remain available. `tests/yeral_route.gd` exercises real jumps, moving-block carry/ascent, camera/scenery separation, audio timing, death and restart. The two-form Yeral/Glizzy lifecycle remains unchanged. The sergeant is the `Sergeant` mini-boss (`scripts/sergeant.gd`, `tests/sergeant_actions.gd`): charge/punch knockback toward the acid, stunning scream wave (`scripts/sergeant_wave.gd`), roid rage at 50% HP (line shown via `YeralRoute._on_sergeant_speech` in the shared comic bubble). He is acid-immune: missed charges fall (`SERGEANT_ACID`/`SERGEANT_BANKS` in `yeral_route.gd`) and he jumps back to the nearest block. Area 3 entry shows a timed "BEWARE! NEW ENEMY!" message instead of a world sign.
- **Bichema's World**: six-area, 8320 px route in `scripts/bichema_route.gd`, matching Yeral's full length, first five area bounds and fade transitions. It follows the full paintings' mapped ground, with only the original Plaza/pub/factory ledges and no unrelated stepped descent or moving-block ascent. Four complete painting instances use three unaltered sources: plaza 2166 px, pub 1805 px, factory 2166 px, and full factory East Wing 2166 px. Natural painting coverage is 8303 px; the final 17 px of arena floor extends the route without stretching the art. The Tacoma drives into the third area before `Capi` (the 12-HP Sergeant) and `Ludo` disembark. `tests/bichema_background.gd` checks map-aligned floor, painted ledges, Tacoma entrance/disembark and Ema's final-area entry.
- Player, mobs enlarged; bosses much larger for visibility. See `guara-art` for sprite pipeline.
- `BichemaRoute._set_area` activates only current-room enemies and waits for that room to clear; room transitions lock controls and fade. All mobs use `zone_min`/`zone_max`; platforms are one-way on `PLATFORM_LAYER` (4), with no random platforms. `MovingPlatform` uses `AnimatableBody2D`/physics-synchronized cosine travel so the player is carried. `WingedMob` remains in both stages. Contact damage is `Bug._touch_damage` (box overlap + margin). Death calls `Player.clear_attacks`: normal/ultimate summons use `player_summons`, player-owned shots use `player_shots`; owner/death guards reject queued hits and dead actions. `tests/death_safety.gd` covers both stages.
- Tests: `tests/*.gd` (run with `--fixed-fps 60 --script`) and `tools/smoke_test.gd`. A failing `assert` makes Godot wait in the debugger, so wrap runs in a timeout. A portable Godot can be downloaded to a scratch folder for validation.

## Menus, difficulty, score

- Final Ema costume defeat now leads to `scenes/end_credits.tscn`, not Level Select: 3s victory banner, 1.2s gameplay fade, then a 43.5s cinematic (`scripts/end_credits.gd`): 6s "To Be Continued.....", 30s centered team roll, 6s "Guaras Game Jam 2026", 1.5s fade to Main Menu. Random original-color animated cast sprites stay in side gutters. `assets/audio/lord_of_the_night.mp3` is the supplied file copied unchanged; credits replace the gameplay loop using `GameAudio.stop_music()`, respect Music mute/volume, fade locally, stop on exit, and let the menu restart the normal loop. Tests: `end_credits` and `level_progression`. Credits text uses non-wrapped Labels with responsive font sizes; zero-width initial autowrap can create huge minimum heights and place the visible text offscreen, so verify the real renderer.

- Level 1 upgrades: `YeralRoute.checkpoint` is session-only, set on area entry, restored on retries, cleared by `GameSettings.begin_run()` and Yeral defeat. Warehouse retry replays the protected first-form intro. Skipped-room enemies are freed without score/loot. Scores retain level-start retry semantics. Sergeant defeat persists `shield_unlocked` alongside `dash_unlocked`; E/L3 activates a 190px/3-damage Shield Burst with 0.6s invulnerability and 6s cooldown. HUD shows readiness. Ordinary enemies can drop eight-second coins or 2HP small cans; fixed cans still heal 4HP. New `Turret` is optional for gates, `Hopper` inherits robot art, and Area 4 has a required flyer. Extra safe-bank healing and secret city coin ledges support pacing/exploration. Regressions: `level1_upgrades`, `yeral_route`, `robot_actions`, `pickups`.
- Every Start Game resets the score and opens `scenes/story_intro.tscn` before Yeral. `StoryIntro` keeps the supplied Penema origin text in `scripts/story_intro.gd`; a one-shot transparent SubViewport renders it for `story_crawl.gdshader`'s gold perspective crawl over code-drawn stars (about 123 seconds). Resolve wrapped Label height after one layout frame before sizing the story texture. Enter/Space/Esc, controller A/B/Start or the focused Skip Intro button fades into the first level; Level Select and restarts bypass it. Existing music/settings are reused. Regression: `tests/story_intro.gd` covers layout, scrolling, resize, skip controls, completion, replay and bypass.
- `InputSetup` maps left stick/D-pad movement, A jump/confirm, X shoot, LB dash, Y summon, RB recall, R3 ultimate and B/Start cancel/pause; B/Start returns from submenus, and menus navigate with D-pad or left stick.
- Scripts: `game_settings.gd` (static settings, save/load to `user://settings.cfg`), `menu_kit.gd` (UI helpers), `main_menu.gd` (title screen from `assets/ui/title_screen.png` + bottom button strip; `title_seen` static skips PRESS START on return), `comic_box.gd` (top-right comic caption used for `main.gd`'s `message`), `level_select.gd`, `settings_menu.gd` (resolution, music/SFX on+volume, difficulty), `game_info.gd` (judge-facing explanation), `pause_menu.gd`.
- Difficulties (`GameSettings.DIFFICULTIES`, hp/damage/aggro multipliers): Baby Guara 0.6/0.5/0.8, Young Guara 1/1/1, Guara 1.5/1.5/1.2, OG Guara 2.5/2/1.5. Applied in `bug/robot/truffle_android/boss_*` and `player.gd`.
- Score: mobs give 1–5 points (`clampi(1 + int(5*x/LEVEL_END), 1, 5)`), bosses 10, coins 5. Medalla cans heal up to 4 HP and stay available when health is full. High score stored per difficulty; HUD and score handling in `main.gd`. Regression: `tests/pickups.gd`.

## Audio (procedural music/effects and recorded voice)
- Yeral's final collapse starts `YeralReward` (`scripts/yeral_reward.gd`) instead of the old three-second banner: 3.2s energy absorption around unaltered player summon sprites, then the recall pose, exact comic bubble "Dime a vel!" and `assets/audio/night_unc_dime_a_vel.wav` through SFX. Hold for at least 2.5s or the full recording, then allow 1s (including a 0.7s fade) before unlocking Dash and opening Bichema. The overlay explicitly uses PAUSABLE processing because its gameplay parent is disabled; death/reload stops the voice and prevents the handoff. The supplied `.ogg` actually contains Opus (unsupported by Godot's Vorbis importer); preserve it under `assets/audio/source/` and decode to mono 44.1kHz PCM with ffmpeg (`-ar 44100 -ac 1 -c:a pcm_s16le`), without trimming or filtering. `tests/yeral_reward.gd` covers timing, locks, pause, mute, cleanup and stage handoff.
- Yeral's supplied MP3 is preserved under `assets/audio/source/` (`.gdignore`); runtime mono 44.1kHz PCM is `assets/audio/yeral_intro.wav`. `node tools/prepare_yeral_audio.js <ffmpeg>` applies high-pass/denoising, about -10dB over the first 0.35 seconds and short fades. Conservative attenuation avoids guessing a speech cut; overlapping background laughter is not guaranteed to be fully removed. The introduction duration follows the stream length even with SFX muted. Do not claim an edit was verified by ear without actual listening.
- `game_audio.gd`: generates 16-bit mono `AudioStreamWAV` at 22050 Hz in code (arpeggio over Am F C G, looped; square-wave SFX `click/kill/hurt/boss`). Buses "Music"/"SFX" created at runtime. Music started in `main_menu._ready` and by the level.
- **Web history/gotchas:** user reported no sound on the deployed build while local worked. Attempts: forcing `playback_type = STREAM` on players and `project.godot` `[audio] general/default_playback_type.web` (STREAM=0, SAMPLE=1; web default is SAMPLE), then rebuilt audio as 16-bit with continuous oscillator phase + attack envelope (old 8-bit/11 kHz version clicked at every note) and `driver/output_latency.web=100`. **Status: last fix (commit 8ccdb6e) unverified by ear.** If still broken, ask which symptom (silent / crackly / stuttering) and try: reverting to SAMPLE playback, starting audio on the first user gesture (browsers block autoplay), checking the browser console.
- Local runs fine; the web is single-threaded so stream mixing happens on the main thread.

## Browser verification
Deployed page is a canvas: use screenshots and console logs, not DOM reading. Console on load should show only engine/WebGL/"single-threaded" lines.

## Working practices that worked
- Edit with proper file edits; write previews to a scratch folder, not into the repo.
- Slice/preview art with the Node tools before wiring into Godot; never alter originals.
- Document behavior changes in `README.md` ("Menus, difficulty and score" section) and in skills.
